title.narrative: SUDLIFT: Supporting, Uplifting, and Developing Local Responders in Sudan

description.narrative: ltpgtThe project aims at strengthening the response capacity of 138 GCTs (72 MAGs/LRs - Local Responders)/Mutual Aid Groups (MAGs) by supporting them with Group Cash transfers and complementary training in River Nile, South Kordofan, North and Central Darfur. During the project duration, MAGs/LRs will be able to respond to the basic needs of the conflict affected populations by providing financial support through GCTs and capacity strengthening trainings to the MAGs/LRs. MAGs/LRs will be equipped with essential tools to conduct needs assessments, surveys and monitoring the activities. Key activities under three key sectors of Food Security and livelihoods will be distribution of food in-kind and communal kitchens. While under the WASH sector the key activities include maintenance repair of water network, distribution of water, installation of solar panels to run the water pumps to provide water, distribution of hygiene kits. Under the protection sector NRC will support the MAGs proposing activities such as emergency evacuation requests, and protection from harsh weather by providing necessary NFI items such as blankets etc. Similarly, the solarization will also complement to protection as the electrification in the camp/nearby washrooms will contribute to mitigate the protection risks and recharge of mobile phones for will strengthen the communication. NRC already have worked with women led MAGs and will prioritize women led MAGs working with IDPs, and Host communities' women and girls to facilitate their access (through direct provision of services such as in-kind support or facilitating with transport) to hygiene and health. ltbrgtGCT, being the unconditional and unrestricted modality, allows the MAGs/LRs to independently prioritize their needs and the number of target population under each key sector is estimated based on the NRCs demonstrated experience. Under the FSL Cluster NRC will reach total 7590 individuals with access to basic food, this assistance will be provided through 33 MAGs out of which 3will be Women-led MAGs. In total 99 GCTs (@5000 US dollar per transfer, total 495,000 US dollar) will be provided to 33 MAGs to implement activities focusing on the conflict affected population.ltbrgtUnder the protection Cluster NRC will reach total 3220 individuals. Under this cluster NRC will provide 14 GCTs (@5000 US dollar per transfer, 70,000 US dollar total) to 14 MAGs (including 2 women led MAGs). ltbrgtUnder the WASH cluster NRC will reach 5750 individuals providing access to basic hygiene. This assistance will be provided through 25 MAGs (including 3 women led MAGs). In total 25 GCTs (@ 5000 US dollar each, total amount 125,000 US dollar) will be provide to these 25 MAGs/LRs. ltbrgtCapacity strengthening is a complimentary component under each cluster, and NRC will provide trainings to 72 MAGs/LRs (33 working in FSL MAGs, 25 working in WASH 14 working in Protection) on Monitoring tool kit, feedback, and response mechanism, needs assessment and activity reporting. The trainings will be conducted through hybrid modality i.e. in-person and remotely by NRC in-house teams from Monitoring, Cash and Market department and/or operationalization support to communal kitchens and access to other basic critical services. ltbrgtNRC will regularly conduct follow ups during the activity implementation and will also maintain the CFM (community feedback and response mechanism) channels with LRs/MAGs and local communities. After activity completion, NRC will conduct PDM (post distribution monitoring) and collect activity completion reports as per F-System of reporting. Throughout the project the primary role of the LRs/MAGs will be to identify the needs in the communities, and through GCTs implement the proposed activites as per the plan.While their role also include submission of activity reports to NRCs as per F-System of reporting. NRC will provide necessary support (GCTs, and Trainings) to LRs/MAGs, maintains CFM system and conduct monitoring of the activities. ltbrgt lt/pgt
